purpose: Test whether broader old-support preservation and localized additive routing reduce unseen old-behavior interference while retaining useful new learning.
selection_rule: Eligible arm must be non-frozen, have positive new_gain in all 10 development populations, maximum final_old deficit <=4, maximum pointwise old_lost <=6, total old_lost <=40, and total new_gain >=800. Among eligible arms choose smallest total old_lost, then largest minimum new_gain, then largest total new_gain, then lowest arm id. If none qualify, choose the non-frozen arm minimizing total old_lost subject to positive aggregate new_gain; mark DEVELOPMENT_GATE_FAILED and treat any allowed validation as exploratory only.

holdout_gate.vs_ordinary_shared_rewrite: selected total new_gain must retain at least 35 percent of arm1 total new_gain and selected total old_lost must be at most 2 percent of arm1 total old_lost
holdout_gate.vs_n15_like_control_arm4: selected total new_gain must retain at least 80 percent of arm4 total new_gain and selected total old_lost must be at most one half of arm4 total old_lost
holdout_gate.localized_preserved_vs_single_dual_arm6: if selected arm is 9 through12, selected total new_gain must retain at least 80 percent of arm6 total new_gain and selected total old_lost must not exceed arm6 total old_lost
holdout_gate.localized_preserved_vs_localized_unprese: if selected arm is 9 through12, selected total new_gain must retain at least 40 percent of arm8 total new_gain and selected total old_lost must be at most one quarter of arm8 total old_lost
holdout_gate.occupancy_preserved_vs_occupancy_unprese: if selected arm is15, selected total new_gain must retain at least 40 percent of arm14 total new_gain and selected total old_lost must be at most one quarter of arm14 total old_lost
holdout_gate.projection_preserved_vs_projection_unpre: if selected arm is18 or19, selected total new_gain must retain at least 40 percent of arm17 total new_gain and selected total old_lost must be at most one quarter of arm17 total old_lost

validation_rule: If native development selection is -1, stop the campaign and do not expose holdouts. Otherwise run the selected arm plus fixed controls on all 16 validation populations exactly once. A real selected arm with development gate0 may run one exploratory validation with the native gate forced0; confirmation is forbidden.
confirmation_rule: Run confirmation only if the native validation gate equals1. Confirmation uses the same selected arm, fixed controls, thresholds, and 16 disjoint populations exactly once.
stage_binding: Freeze native N16_DEV_SELECTION and complete development stdout hash before validation. Freeze native N16_HOLDOUT_GATE for validation and complete validation stdout hash before confirmation. Operational parsing may not recompute scientific metrics outside Zag.
stage_rerun_policy: Each scientific stage is consumed by its first actual invocation regardless of outcome. No retries, retuning, arm substitution, threshold changes, or population reuse.
old_support_roles: The second old-support set is training-side only. Dual-support preservation arms2,6,7,11,12,19 evaluate synthetic old-target correctness on those support inputs and use resulting protected-behavior loss only to accept or reject proposed updates. Dual-old-support occupancy arms14 and15 additionally use unlabeled support-input occupancy counts in the routing veto. The support set never contributes probe outcomes, task ids, evaluator bits, or gradient/update fitting.
